title: Updating the suffix-length word
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers with $l>0$, and let $s,u,v,a$ be Boolean words. Replacing the word at the first suffix-length-bank position in the host layout for $(s,u,v)$ by $a$ gives exactly the host layout for $(s,u,a)$.
replaced:
Replacing the word at the first length-bank slot of the host layout for
$(s, u, v)$ by a word $a$ yields exactly the layout for $(s, u, a)$; the
candidate and width words are preserved.
